baseUrl.description: The base URL of the external platform (optional).

errorsWebhookUrl.description:
The URL where notifications for any issues will be sent.
Required for [`error` notificationTypes](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/prod/operation/operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode#operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode-body-application-json-notificationtypes).
See [Get Sample Error notification](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/operation/operation-reservationErrorNotification).

integrationWebhookUrl.description:
The URL where notifications for activation or deactivation of the customer's integration will be sent.
Required for [`integration` notificationTypes](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/prod/operation/operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode#operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode-body-application-json-notificationtypes).
See [Integration notification](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/operation/operation-reservationintegrationnotification).

notificationTypes.description: The events that trigger a notification.

onboardingWebhookUrl.description:
The URL where notifications for the customer's integration onboarding will be sent.
Required for [`onboarding` notificationTypes](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/prod/operation/operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode#operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode-body-application-json-notificationtypes).
See [Onboarding notification](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/prod/operation/operation-reservationonboardingnotification).

orderWebhookUrl.description:
The URL where order notifications will be sent.
Required for [`order` notificationTypes](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/prod/operation/operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode#operation-reservation-servicesetbyplatformcode-body-application-json-notificationtypes).
See [Order Notification](https://api-docs.lsk.lightspeed.app/prod/operation/operation-reservationordernotification).

posReservationUpdateWebhookUrl.description: The URL where notifications about reservation changes on POS will be sent.

ownNotificationsOnly.description: When `true`, notifications will only be sent for orders linked to the reservation platform.

webhookAuthDetails.description: The authentication credentials to be sent with the webhook notifications.

webhookAuthType.description: The type of authentication used by the webhook.

allowCourseNumberUpdates.description: If true, table statuses can be customized using a number format.

inServiceTableStatuses.description: List of customizable table statuses that will be used to notify platforms about reservation progress with outbound API.

reservation-servicePlatformAPIKeysWebhoo.description: The API keys that will be sent with the webhook notifications. See [API Keys](https://swagger.io/docs/specification/authentication/api-keys/).

additionalProperties.description: Key-value pairs of arbitrary static headers to send with the webhook request.
Key-value pairs of arbitrary static query parameters to send with the webhook request.

reservation-servicePlatformBasicAuthWebh.description: The basic authentication credentials that will be sent with the webhook notifications. See [Basic Authentication](https://swagger.io/docs/specification/authentication/basic-authentication/).

reservation-servicePlatformBearerTokenWe.description: The bearer token that will be sent with the webhook notifications. See [Bearer Authentication](https://swagger.io/docs/specification/authentication/bearer-authentication/).

reservation-servicePlatformDepositSuppor.description: Whether or not the platform supports deposits.

reservation-servicePlatformDisplayName.description: The official platform name that will be displayed.

reservation-servicePlatformOAuth2Webhook.description: The OAuth2 credentials that will be sent with the webhook notifications. See [OAuth 2.0](https://oauth.net/2/).

authorizationGrantType.description: The authorization grant type. See [OAuth2 Grant Types](https://oauth.net/2/grant-types/).

clientAuthorizationMethod.description: The client authorization method. See [OAuth2 Client Authentication](https://oauth.net/2/client-authentication/).

providerJwkSetUri.description: The external platform URL for getting public keys to verify given access tokens on the K-Series side.

providerTokenUri.description: The external platform URL for getting access tokens by private credentials.

scopes.description: The scopes being granted to the API client.

statusLabel.description: The unique text which will be displayed in the back-office for users.

statusValue.description: The unique code which will be used for outbound communication within table status mapping.

sequence.description: This number is used to resolve collisions between statuses in order of highest priority.
